t: 宗教改革者约翰·威克利夫被谴责为康斯坦斯议会的异教徒.
te: Religious reformer John Wycliffe is condemned as a heretic at the Council of Constance.
dz: 宗教改革者约翰·威克利夫被谴责为康斯坦斯议会的异教徒.
de: Religious reformer John Wycliffe is condemned as a heretic at the Council of Constance.

t: 扬·胡斯被康斯坦茨大教堂的公会大会谴责为异教徒并被判被活活活烧死.
te: Jan Hus is condemned by the assembly of the council in the Konstanz Cathedral as a heretic and sentenced to be burned a…
dz: 扬·胡斯被康斯坦茨大教堂的公会大会谴责为异教徒并被判被活活活烧死.
de: Jan Hus is condemned by the assembly of the council in the Konstanz Cathedral as a heretic and sentenced to be burned at the stake.

t: 托马斯·格雷因参与"南安普顿地块"被处决.
te: Thomas Grey is executed for participating in the Southampton Plot.
dz: 托马斯·格雷因参与"南安普顿地块"被处决.
de: Thomas Grey is executed for participating in the Southampton Plot.

t: 英国入侵法国始于英国国王亨利五世在法国登陆.
te: The English invasion of France begins when English king Henry V lands in France.
dz: 英国入侵法国始于英国国王亨利五世在法国登陆.
de: The English invasion of France begins when English king Henry V lands in France.

t: 航海家亨利带领葡萄牙军队在休达征服会战胜马里尼德人.
te: Henry the Navigator leads Portuguese forces to victory over the Marinids at the Conquest of Ceuta.
dz: 航海家亨利带领葡萄牙军队在休达征服会战胜马里尼德人.
de: Henry the Navigator leads Portuguese forces to victory over the Marinids at the Conquest of Ceuta.

t: 英格兰的亨利五世与他手下和弓箭手一起在阿金库尔战役中击败了更大的法军.
te: Henry V of England, with his men-at-arms and archers, defeats the larger French army in the Battle of Agincourt.
dz: 百年之战:英格兰的亨利五世与他手下和弓箭手一起在阿金库尔战役中击败了更大的法军.
de: Hundred Years' War: Henry V of England, with his men-at-arms and archers, defeats the larger French army in the Battle of Agincourt.
